judge_verdict.summary: The agent analyzed the miRNA Ct table but submitted 36% from a Welch t-test on all samples, while the benchmark ground truth is 28%, so the verifier correctly failed.

verdict.outcome_rationale: This is a genuine agent-fault failure and the verifier's FAIL is correct. The hidden verifier read `/workspace/answer.txt`, compared it to the structured ground truth with exact percentage matching, and reported reward 0 because the agent submitted 36% against ideal 28% [1][2]. The task asked for the percentage of miRNAs significantly differentially expressed before multiple-testing correction and to write only that number to `/workspace/answer.txt` [3], and the reference capsule answer is 28% [4][5]. The agent loaded the sole data file `pone.0150501.s002.xls`, installed `xlrd`, identified 175 miRNAs with 10 patient (`P_*`) and 10 control (`C_*`) Ct columns, and ran per-miRNA two-group tests; its exploratory run reported Welch 63/175 (36.0%), Student 67/175 (38.3%), and Mann–Whitney 59/175 (33.7%) on raw Ct [6], and a broader comparison again showed raw Welch 63/175 = 36.0% uncorrected while the third tuple element 28 was the Benjamini–Hochberg-adjusted significant count, not an uncorrected percentage [7]. Despite seeing those alternatives, it chose the raw Welch uncorrected rate and wrote `36%` to `/workspace/answer.txt` [8][9]. That 36% figure is internally consistent with its own code path but does not match the benchmark's 28% target, so the agent did not genuinely accomplish the scored task even though it performed a real analysis on the provided data [1][6][8].
